title: Vividly Tangy Polish Pork Casserole
description: A tangy and gooey Polish dish featuring a rich sauce and tender pork, perfect for a midnight craving. This keto-friendly casserole is cooked to perfection in a bain-marie.

ingredients.name: dried mushrooms
ingredients.notes: rehydrated in 1 cup of hot water

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the pork cubes over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sour cream, rehydrated mushrooms, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked pork and onion mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with shredded cheese.
Place the baking dish in a larger dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
